description: A diagnosis adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained recommender through a stable compatibility interface and generates an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions.
motivation: Support evidence-based model improvements while preserving RecHarness evaluation comparability and avoiding assumptions about unavailable reviews, item attributes, or simulator traits.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics and metric_definitions. Probe view.model as the actual trained nn.Module; adapt feature and scoring probes when the architecture changes. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B x L. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Mark unavailable information as unobserved. Preserve all four datasets and routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Select trials using macro validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator. Update the predictor writer whenever inference changes.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    initialize(view, device)
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        switch view.model to evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            collect supported measurements from histories and batches
            obtain features and scores through architecture-compatible methods
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_values, metric_definitions: definitions}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    render measured metrics alongside their definitions
    state missing evidence explicitly
    request grounded interpretations and testable model changes

originality.positive: Combines a stable diagnostic interface with explicit evidence and benchmark constraints.
originality.negative: The supplied content specifies an adapter contract rather than a new recommendation algorithm or diagnostic method.

future_potential.positive: Can support comparable diagnosis across architecture changes and iterative recommendation experiments.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on the quality of implemented probes and whether their findings improve validation HR@10.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interface and batch format are explicit.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture-specific probing, faithful metric definitions, and synchronized predictor generation require careful implementation.
